Method of Attack: Exploiting vulnerabilities in routers for remote code execution
Exploiting or misusing network edge applications and services
Impacted Systems: Small office and home office (SOHO) routers
Routers and VPN appliances from brands like TP-Link, Zyxel, Asus, Axentra, D-Link, NETGEAR
Attack Vector: Password spray operations originating from compromised devices
Indicators of Compromise: Downloaded Telnet binary from remote FTP server
Downloaded xlogin backdoor binary from remote FTP server
